about_the_game:
"Welcome to the demo!

This is the beginning of our story, giving you a glimpse into the atmosphere, characters, and core mechanics of the game.

However, please keep in mind that the final version may differ: the plot may be expanded, scenes reworked, and details improved.

We appreciate your feedback, as it will help make the game even better. Thank you for embarking on this journey with us!"
